scope: CPU independent minimal top-prefix deployment control under relaxed at-most-k budgets; frozen pooled-score floor only, no O/LSE/task-quality/GPU/capacity/novelty claim. Not an exact-k competitor.
input_cells: All same 3 documents, rank0/layer15, B3/B3/B4, both KV heads and budgets4096/16384; 12 head cells per epsilon. Exact source hashes inherited from pinned source protocol.
selection: For each request independently, preserve first4/last32 document positions and choose shortest prefix of its optional scores in descending order with lower original token ID tie-break. Start from canonical protected top-k. Never exchange tokens with another request.
constraint: Selected cardinality <= original k, NOT exactly k. Actual fsum score loss <= epsilon*original score AND relative loss <= epsilon. Binary search computes actual fsum; no tolerance. Validate immediately shorter prefix fails unless mandatory alone suffices.
epsilon_zero: Use the same minimal-prefix rule, no shortcut to exactly-k. Zero-valued or fsum-unresolved trailing scores may theoretically permit fewer tokens; record actual result, do not claim real-arithmetic zero loss.
private_policy: Actual partial-page document tail is protected and unchanged; only common-source interval counts toward physical-sharing candidate union. System/question/generated private KV never altered or consumed by this CPU screen.
outputs: Every request cardinality, selected-index SHA, actual score loss, previous-prefix infeasibility; sum selected entries and common-source union; per-variant CPU/wall cost; direct comparison to frozen exchange at same floor with different cardinality explicitly labeled.
freeze: Commit protocol and implementation after toy self-test, before natural CPU result computation; no post-outcome order/epsilon tuning, rerun refuses existing outputs.
resource_limit: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, 1 Torch thread, 120 seconds wall timeout; retain failures; no GPU allocation.
